simple.meaning: יָשֵׁן (yâshên) appears 21 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 2:21. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָשֵׁן (H3462) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows יָשֵׁן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: properly, to be slack or languid , i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die ); also to grow old , stale or inveterate
definitions.full: H3462. yashen [ יָשֵׁן ] verb sleep (Late Hebrew id.; Aramaic noun sleep ; Arabic be sleepy , , sleep Assyrian šittiu , sleep , Dl HWB 246 , šunatu, šuttu , dream , Id ib, Flood: iv. 22 Asrb Annals,v R. 2, 97 ) — Qal Perfect יָשַׁנְתִּי Job 3:13 ; וְיָָֽשְׁנוּ consecutive Jer 51:39 2 t.; Imperfect יִישָׁ֑ן Isa 5:27 ; Psa 121:4 ; וַיִישַׁן 1Kin 19:5 , etc.; Infinitive construct לִישׁוֺן Eccl 5:11 ; — sleep, go to sleep , and be asleep , Gen 2:21 (J), 41:5 (E), Ezek 34:25 ; Job 3:13 ; Psa 3:6 ; Psalm 4:9; Prov 4:16 ; Eccl 5:11 , also 2Sam 4:6 ᵐ5 We Dr Kit Bu, see חֹמֶשׁ ; with לֹא , of Ass. army Isa 5:27 (|| נוּם ); of Baal 1Kin 19:5 ; of אֲדֹנָי תִישַׁן לָמָּה עוּרָה ׳י, 1Ki 44:24; יִישָׁ֑ן לֹא 12:14 (|| נוּם ); with accusative of congnate meaning with verb ׳ישׁ עוֺלָם שְׁנַת Jer 51:39 , 57 (see שֵׁנָה ), of death, compare הַמָּוֶת אִישַׁן Psa 13:4 . Niph`al only in derivatives sense of become inactive or stationary; Perfect וְנוֺשַׁנְתֶּם consecutive Deut 4:25 and ye be grown old בָּאָרֶץ , i.e. (see Di Dr) have lost freshness of first impressions; of inanimate things, be old, stale , only Participle נוֺשָׁן יָשָׁן Lev 26:10 (H), feminine נוֺשֶׁנֶת צרעת 13:11 = old leprosy (P); these possibly denominative from יָשָׁן Pi`el causat .
